case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear colleagues at Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH,

Thank you for your quote and for explaining your position.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3). Our should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).

We have analysed the cost situation of this part carefully; the options below reflect that analysis.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 27.01 per unit, lead time 42 days, 23,400 units per year, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 26.27 per unit, lead time 56 days, 23,400 units per year, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 27.01 per unit, lead time 35 days, 23,400 units per year, 24-month agreement.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We look forward to your view on these options.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Furthermore, we checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your should-cost estimate; however, as a matter of policy, we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We can accommodate the requested volume of 23,400 units and a 24-month contract, provided the lead time is set to 56 days. For this configuration, we propose a revised unit price of EUR 31.70.

Our Angebot is a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
